visual_review.method: Viewed the full final PNG, the decoded final JPEG, and an enlarged in-memory crop of both hands. Counted each hand after local corrections; compared cave framing, major cracks, crystals, and lighting with the bare cave.
limitations: AI editing softened some fine rock texture; exact background pixel preservation is not claimed.
The small JPEG makes individual fingers less distinct than the full-resolution wall.

tool_limitations: Finite catalog and numeric release grammar only; not a package installer or complete ecosystem lockfile.
Example excludes Python/platform constraints, conditional dependencies, and extras.
Budget/depth limits return inconclusive rather than claiming no solution.
